Elastic prismatic lintel with declared zero-movement end restraints. Ideal thin rectangular strips; strong-axis
gross-yield bending and shear upper-bound screens only. Single = one plate/profile; Double = two
independent identical sections assumed to share actions equally, without composite action.
Local/distortional/lateral-torsional and shear buckling, holes, connection slip, load eccentricity, bearing, wall
jambs and fastening remain pending. Not an AS/NZS 4600 design capacity or construction approval.
Web/chord frame contribution to stiffness and strength is not credited in the plate-only screen; skin
fastening and compression plate buckling remain pending.

Engineering basis
Elastic prismatic lintel with declared zero-movement end restraints. Ideal thin rectangular strips; strong-axis
gross-yield bending and shear upper-bound screens only. Single = one plate/profile; Double = two independent
identical sections assumed to share actions equally, without composite action. Local/distortional/lateral-torsional
and shear buckling, holes, connection slip, load eccentricity, bearing, wall jambs and fastening remain pending. Not
an AS/NZS 4600 design capacity or construction approval. Web/chord frame contribution to stiffness and strength is
not credited in the plate-only screen; skin fastening and compression plate buckling remain pending.
Ultimate wind must already be an ultimate action. Site pressures and complete project combinations remain
pending.
Plate-only elastic screen: frame stiffness is not credited. Frame self-weight and steel quantities are included.
Double sections require equal load sharing and a designed connection; no composite stiffness is credited.
